The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph, and a vehicle is executing a cut-in maneuver from the adjacent lane into the ego vehicle's path. The cut-in vehicle is approaching from the front-right (positive x, positive y) and moving towards the ego lane (target_y_m=0.0). Given the relative speeds and the cut-in trajectory, the ego vehicle needs to slow down to maintain a safe following distance and allow the cut-in to complete safely. A1 (decelerate) is the appropriate action.
